notes: TBox relation insert: every derived query computes a Hallam index from a length (fol).

queries.not_checked: fol (arithmetic): side from perimeter, then 3 × side
fol (arithmetic): side from area, then 3 × side

fol.notes: The Hallam index is a fictional attribute (local). Side lengths are positive (firm), which picks the root of area = side². The cube's face f has sides equal to the cube's edges (stated with the given face).

local.hallam_index: fictional: the Hallam index of a square (this record's edit)

perimeter_rule.says: The perimeter of a square is four times its side length.

cube_faces.says: Every face of a cube is a square.

area_rule.says: The area of a square is the square of its side length.

abcd.says: Square ABCD is a square with sides of length 5.

efgh.says: Square EFGH has a perimeter of 20 centimetres.

face.says: f is a face of a cube whose edges are 2 units long (so its sides are 2 long).

jklm.says: Square JKLM has an area of 49 square metres.
